choices.reason: No primary or main novelty specification is singled out, so rule 2 favors the unadjusted descriptive contrasts over the regression. Rule 6 resolves the remaining individual/team tie in favor of Individual AI versus Individual No AI, holding collaboration at its baseline individual level; no pooled AI-versus-no-AI contrast is available among the candidates.
choices.locator: PDF p. 5, Methodology, Procedures, first paragraph (factorial design); PDF p. 6, Data analysis strategy and Tables 2-3 (descriptive contrasts and regression).
choices.quote: This design structure was selected as it enables the simultaneous examination of two central factors: GenAI availability (present vs. absent) and collaboration structure (individual vs. team-based), as well as their interactive effects on innovation outcomes.
